notes.title: Touchdown Girls Content Patch Update v0.01-014
notes.notes:
Touchdown Girls Content Patch Update v0.01-014 includes several bug fixes for issues that were reported by users in our game forums. 

- Included formatting of Centerfold Gallery Images
- Choice selection in the Art Studio to allow Shona to keep her robe on during the modeling scene before advancing to the next scene

We'll continue to check the forums for new bugs that are being reported and continue to issue patches to the game

notes.title: Spanish Language / Latin America Translation Update
notes.notes: Responding to feedback from our user forums, we've improved and updated the Spanish Language / Latin America Translation version of Touchdown Girls. With this small update we've spent additional time to ensure that Spanish language users have the best user experience possible while playing the game.

notes.title: Cheers! Touchdown Girls is now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Cheers! We've gone live and the official release of Touchdown Girls is now available on PC and Mac platforms on Steam. This new visual novel from Entropy Digital Entertainment contains all of the uncensored animation scenes and racy nude girl centerfolds and scenarios in fun story that will both make you laugh as well as get you heart racing. 

All the game sequences and animation scene have been mastered at a 1080p native resolution to ensure the highest quality and detail in any visual novel that you can find available. All sequences also include multiple choices that will allow you to unlock the 18+ NSFW content easily with the ability to save the sequences for easy viewing later. 

The game now also includes a HD centerfold gallery unlocked by playing though the game as well as a complete achievement system that will reward you as you continue to progress though the game. We've also included built in translations for Chinese, French and Spanish as well as English for international players. We hope that you will enjoy this new college themed adventure and we hope to be able to grow the story for your enjoyment in the future.

notes.title: Touchdown Girls v1.01 release build now online for curators
notes.notes:
In anticipation of the Thursday release of Touchdown Girl, we are early releasing the game today for Steam Curators and Influencers on both PC and MacOS based systems to play and review. We've been working on the HD renders and animations for over a year and we're happy to finally be able to get the game into the hands of Visual Novel players all over the world. 

We look forward to seeing what players think of the college environment that we've created to tell the story of Mike Meuller and his quest to become the starting quarterback of the Bingham Hornets football team. 

While the currently release story in complete, we will be adding several items before and throughout the launch such as additional achievements, additional game translations and special bonus HD centerfolds to the awards gallery as you play though the game. Stay tuned for future updates and we hope that you will enjoy playing Touchdown Girls.
